topic: How a Trust Score is built
headline: How a Trust Score is built
text: Carousel, 7 slides: What's inside a Trust Score? / 01 Regulation / 02 Reviews / 03 Transparency / 04 Footprint / 05 Complaints / No pay-to-rank. Read the methodology.
caption:
What's inside a Trust Score? Five factors: regulation, reviews, transparency, footprint and complaints. The formula and weights are published on our methodology page, and no broker can pay to move up.

A score is where your research starts, not a recommendation.
